message:
Review before saving: first compile of "Board Documents" (16 sources: 15 documents, 1 recording; no exclusions). Proposed file: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md in Board Documents/Almanac. Nothing has been saved.

Changelog: first compile, no previous version, so every topic is new.

Current rules, with quotations:
- Monthly fee: $240 per unit from 2026-03-01 (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0): "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026." The $230 in the Feb 2025 notice was corrected by the 2025-04-15 minutes; $225 applied 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01.
- Pets: CONFLICT. 2025-04-15 minutes (3-0): "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed." 2019 bylaws/house rules: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet." and "Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds." The 2019 document does not say whether the pet rule is Part A (owner vote) or Part B (board vote), so I could not decide which applies.
- Renovations: Mon-Fri 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. from 2024-07-15 (minutes 2024-06-12, 3-0): "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024." No work Sundays or holidays.
- Balconies: heat pump units permitted with written approval if floor-mounted, not on railing, at most 60 dB(A) (minutes 2025-01-23, vote 2-1). Barbecues and open flames prohibited on balconies (2019): "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies."
- Quiet hours: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night (2019): "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."
- Rentals: minimum lease term 30 days from 2025-04-15 (minutes, 2-1): "the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately." Replaced six months.
- Parking: guest vehicles up to 48 hours from 2025-10-01 (minutes 2025-09-10, 3-0): "guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025." Replaced 72 hours.
- EV charging: allowed in assigned spaces with written board approval, licensed electrician, owner cost (minutes 2026-01-20, 3-0).
- Pool hours, 2026 season: CONFLICT. Minutes 2025-09-10 (3-0): "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily." Notice 2026-05-01: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." Pool opens June 1, 2026.
- Vendor contracts: INCOMPLETE. Bramblewick Grounds LLC, term April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026, $1,450 per month. Auto-renews unless notice at least 60 days before term end (i.e. by 2026-01-30). Minutes 2025-09-10 directed non-renewal notice by January 30, 2026. The email is dated 2026-02-02. The folder does not establish whether the agreement ended or renewed, so no outcome is stated.
- Officers: board of three, quorum two; new Treasurer appointed 2025-09-10 until the next annual meeting.
- Governance: Part A bylaws amended by two-thirds owner vote; Part B house rules by majority board vote.

Open items: non-renewal notice (Secretary, due 2026-01-30, sent 2026-02-02 per email); 2024 budget to owners (Treasurer, due 2024-02-15, no completion recorded); renovation hours notice (closed, dated 2024-07-01); balcony engineer opinion (closed, received 2025-01-15); from the 2026-06-18 recording, provisional: insurer question on electric barbecues (Secretary, end of July 2026, passed, no record), pool-hours question (Treasurer, "next time"), barbecue motion for September agenda (Board, not in folder).

Provisional items (3, all from the 2026-06-18 recording, none adopted): electric barbecues (board leans to allowing, no vote); pool-hours objection; Treasurer follow-up.

Exclusions: none.
